forms.name: Kindlit
forms.nameFrom: kindle + lit: a tiny round puff, like a spark that just caught
forms.desc: A round little puff of warm fluff. When it is happy, the top of its head glows like a match that just lit.

forms.name: Fluffurn
forms.nameFrom: fluff + burn: the puff grows a fluffy curled tail that glows
forms.desc: Its fluffy tail curls up and glows pink at the tip. It hops so fast it leaves a warm trail in the grass.

forms.name: Blazeplume
forms.nameFrom: blaze + plume: a big puff with a crest of fiery feathers
forms.desc: A big, proud puff with a plume of flame colored fur on top. It fluffs up to twice its size when it battles.

forms.name: Driftlet
forms.nameFrom: snow drift + little: a small pointed pile of snow with a face
forms.desc: A small pile of snow that wiggles. It hides in snow drifts and pops out to say hello.

forms.name: Frostkit
forms.nameFrom: frost + kit (a baby cat): the snow pile grows cat ears and paws
forms.desc: The snow pile grows two pointy ears and four paws. It purrs, and the air around it turns cold.

forms.name: Blizzlynx
forms.nameFrom: blizzard + lynx: a big snow cat with a huge fluffy tail
forms.desc: A big snow cat with tufted ears and a tail like a snow cloud. One swish of its tail makes a tiny blizzard.

forms.name: Sprotato
forms.nameFrom: sprout + potato: a round tater body with a sprout on top
forms.desc: A round little tater with a sprout on its head. It sunbathes all day to make its sprout grow.

forms.name: Shrubtato
forms.nameFrom: shrub + potato: the sprout grows into a leafy shrub
forms.desc: Its sprout has grown into a bushy shrub. Little birds like to rest in its leaves.

forms.name: Grovetato
forms.nameFrom: grove + potato: a big tater with a whole grove of leaves
forms.desc: A strong tater with a crown of big leaves, like a small grove of trees. It stomps to wake up sleepy seeds.

forms.name: Gloomochi
forms.nameFrom: gloom + mochi (a round rice cake): a round, squishy purple ball
forms.desc: A round, squishy ball that only comes out after the sun goes down. It bounces when it giggles.

forms.name: Duskmochi
forms.nameFrom: dusk + mochi: the squishy ball grows round bunny ears
forms.desc: The squishy ball grows two round ears. It can hear a leaf fall from across the field.

forms.name: Nightmochi
forms.nameFrom: night + mochi: a big round night bear with a pale belly
forms.desc: A big, round night bear with a soft pale belly. It gives the best hugs in the whole night grove.

forms.name: Cubbloop
forms.nameFrom: cube + bloop: a little square blob of water jelly
forms.desc: A little square of water jelly. You can see bubbles floating inside it.

forms.name: Gloopillar
forms.nameFrom: gloop + pillar: the jelly stretches up tall like a pillar
forms.desc: The jelly stretches up tall like a pillar. It can squeeze through any crack.

forms.name: Gelossus
forms.nameFrom: gel + colossus (a giant): a giant, wobbly jelly
forms.desc: A giant, wobbly jelly as big as a pond. Fish sometimes swim right through it.

forms.name: Cindrakit
forms.nameFrom: cinder + drake (a dragon) + kit: a baby dragon the size of a kitten
forms.desc: A baby dragon the size of a kitten. It practices breathing fire, but only makes little puffs of smoke.

forms.name: Cindracub
forms.nameFrom: cinder + drake + cub: a bigger dragon cub with a flame tail
forms.desc: A dragon cub with a flame on its tail. It sits up tall to look bigger.

forms.name: Cindrake
forms.nameFrom: cinder + drake: a young dragon with horns and claws
forms.desc: A young dragon with strong horns and a flame tipped tail. It guards its friends.

forms.name: Infernadrake
forms.nameFrom: inferno + drake: a huge winged dragon wrapped in flame
forms.desc: A huge dragon with wide wings and a crown of horns. Its flames glow like a sunset.

forms.name: Sandlet
forms.nameFrom: sand + little: a tiny round ball of sand with eyes
forms.desc: A tiny ball of sand with big eyes. It rolls across the dunes when the wind blows.

forms.name: Siltcoil
forms.nameFrom: silt (fine sand) + coil: the sand ball stretches into a short coiled snake
forms.desc: The sand ball stretches out into a short, coiled snake. It wiggles to dig little tunnels.

forms.name: Dunecoil
forms.nameFrom: dune + coil: a long sand snake coiled up like a sand dune
forms.desc: A long sand snake that coils into a pile as tall as a dune. It naps in warm sand.

forms.name: Spinecoil
forms.nameFrom: spine + coil: a giant coiled snake with a mane of sand spikes
forms.desc: A giant coiled snake with a mane of sharp sand spikes. When it shakes, it makes a sandstorm.

forms.name: Mosslet
forms.nameFrom: moss + little: a small horned stone with moss on its belly
forms.desc: A small horned stone with soft moss on its belly. It sits so still that bugs think it is a rock.

forms.name: Mosshorn
forms.nameFrom: moss + horn: the stone grows two big horns and a leafy tail
forms.desc: The stone grows two big horns. A tuft of leaves sprouts from its back.

forms.name: Mossbrick
forms.nameFrom: moss + brick: a strong body made of brick shaped stones
forms.desc: Its body is made of brick shaped stones held together with moss. It loves to build.

forms.name: Mossgolith
forms.nameFrom: moss + golem + monolith (a giant stone): a giant stone giant with leaves
forms.desc: A giant made of stone blocks and leafy vines. It can carry a whole tree on its back.

forms.name: Wispling
forms.nameFrom: wisp (a little glow) + ling: a tiny glowing white blob
forms.desc: A tiny white blob that glows like a night light. It follows lost travelers home.

forms.name: Halopod
forms.nameFrom: halo + cephalopod (an octopus or squid): a small ghost squid with a golden halo
forms.desc: A small white squid with a golden halo over its head. Its halo hums softly.

forms.name: Seraphopod
forms.nameFrom: seraph (an angel) + cephalopod: a squid with angel wing fins
forms.desc: A squid with wing shaped fins and a bright halo. It floats in the air like it is swimming.

forms.name: Celestopod
forms.nameFrom: celestial (of the sky and stars) + cephalopod: a huge starlit squid with a crown halo
forms.desc: A huge, shining squid with a crown shaped halo and sparkles all around it. It lights up the whole night.

forms.name: Plumpup
forms.nameFrom: plume (a big feather) + pup: a chubby pup with a fan of peacock feathers
forms.desc: A chubby pup with a fan of purple feathers on its back. It shows off its fan to make friends.

forms.name: Plumrus
forms.nameFrom: plume + walrus: a walrus with tusks and a feather fan
forms.desc: A walrus with two little tusks and a big feather fan. It flaps its fan to cool off in the sun.

forms.name: Tuskplume
forms.nameFrom: tusk + plume: a huge dark walrus with long tusks and a giant fan
forms.desc: A huge walrus with long tusks and a giant fan of feathers. When it spreads its fan, every eye on it seems to stare.

forms.name: Chamelet
forms.nameFrom: chameleon + little: a baby lizard with a curly tail and a pink crest
forms.desc: A baby lizard with a curly tail and a fuzzy pink crest. Its crest crackles when it gets excited.

forms.name: Chamohawk
forms.nameFrom: chameleon + mohawk: the crest grows into a tall spiky mohawk
forms.desc: Its crest has grown into a tall, spiky mohawk that sparks like a toy plasma ball.

forms.name: Chamoroar
forms.nameFrom: chameleon + roar: a big dark lizard with a wild glowing crest
forms.desc: A big lizard that turns dark when it battles. Its glowing crest crackles when it roars.

forms.name: Toucapus
forms.nameFrom: toucan + octopus: a toucan beak on a little octopus body
forms.desc: A little octopus with a big toucan beak. It flaps its arms like wings to fly over the lake.

forms.name: Krakeucan
forms.nameFrom: kraken (a giant sea monster) + toucan: a giant beaked sea creature with many arms
forms.desc: A giant sea creature with a toucan beak and long curling arms. It can swim and fly.

forms.name: Quillit
forms.nameFrom: quill (a spine) + little: a red fox pup with a little shell and spines
forms.desc: A red pup with a small turtle shell on its back and soft spines. It curls up when it is shy.

forms.name: Shellquill
forms.nameFrom: shell + quill: a bigger shell with long spines
forms.desc: Its shell grows bigger and its spines grow longer. Its back is always warm, like a heater.

forms.name: Magmaquill
forms.nameFrom: magma (hot melted rock) + quill: a dark spiky ball that rolls like a hot rock
forms.desc: Dark spikes cover its whole back. It curls into a hot, spiky ball and rolls into battle.

forms.name: Puffawn
forms.nameFrom: puffer fish + fawn (a baby deer): a round puffer fish with little antlers
forms.desc: A round puffer fish with tiny antlers, like a baby deer. It puffs up when it giggles.

forms.name: Pufflope
forms.nameFrom: puffer fish + antelope: a puffer with legs and bigger antlers
forms.desc: It grows strong legs and bigger antlers. It runs along the shore and splashes in the waves.

forms.name: Puffstag
forms.nameFrom: puffer fish + stag (a grown deer): a big spiky puffer with huge antlers
forms.desc: A big, spiky puffer with huge antlers. It opens its mouth wide to give a mighty splash.

forms.name: Pinchmur
forms.nameFrom: pinch + lemur: a lemur with a striped tail and little red crab claws
forms.desc: A lemur with a striped tail and two little red crab claws. It pinches leaves off trees to snack on.

forms.name: Clawmur
forms.nameFrom: claw + lemur: bigger claws and a red crab shell on its head
forms.desc: Its claws grow big and it wears a red crab shell like a helmet.

forms.name: Crushmur
forms.nameFrom: crush + lemur: a huge lemur with giant crab claws
forms.desc: A huge lemur with giant crab claws. It can crack open a coconut with one snap.

forms.name: Whalump
forms.nameFrom: whale + lump: a round little whale lump with a water spout
forms.desc: A round little whale that sits on the beach like a lump. It sprays water from its spout to say hi.

forms.name: Spoutump
forms.nameFrom: spout + lump: a bigger whale lump with a strong spout
forms.desc: A bigger whale with a strong spout. Kids splash in the fountain it makes.

forms.name: Leviathump
forms.nameFrom: leviathan (a giant sea creature) + lump: a giant whale with many legs
forms.desc: A giant whale that walks on many legs. Its big mouth can gulp a whole wave.

forms.name: Flutteroo
forms.nameFrom: flutter + kangaroo: a little hopping roo with butterfly wings
forms.desc: A little roo with butterfly wings. It hops and flutters at the same time.

forms.name: Mothroo
forms.nameFrom: moth + kangaroo: a fuzzy roo with big moth wings and antennae
forms.desc: A fuzzy roo with big moth wings and feathery antennae. It glides from hill to hill.

forms.name: Mothdrake
forms.nameFrom: moth + drake (a dragon): a dragon shaped roo with moth wings
forms.desc: It grows a long dragon tail and strong legs, and its moth wings carry it high above the clouds.

forms.name: Crabitty
forms.nameFrom: crab + bitty: a tiny pink critter with crab claws and bat wings
forms.desc: A tiny pink critter with crab claws and little bat wings. It snips the air to say hello.

forms.name: Crabat
forms.nameFrom: crab + bat: long legs, bat wings and crab claws
forms.desc: It stands on long legs, flaps its bat wings and snaps its crab claws to keep a beat.

forms.name: Crabatross
forms.nameFrom: crab + bat + albatross (a giant sea bird): a big winged crab bat
forms.desc: A big crab bat with wide wings like an albatross. It glides over the night sea for hours.

forms.name: Snailark
forms.nameFrom: snail + lark (a songbird): a little bird with a snail shell on its back
forms.desc: A little songbird with a snail shell on its back. It sings slow, sleepy songs.

forms.name: Spiralhawk
forms.nameFrom: spiral + hawk: a hawk with spiral shell wings
forms.desc: A hawk with wings shaped like spiral shells. It spins as it dives.

forms.name: Kittowl
forms.nameFrom: kitten + owl: a round black kitten with owl ears and big eyes
forms.desc: A round black kitten with owl tufts and big golden eyes. It sleeps all day and plays all night.

forms.name: Shadowl
forms.nameFrom: shadow + owl: a tall shadow owl cat with wide wings
forms.desc: A tall shadow owl with wide wings. It glides so quietly that nobody hears it coming.
